title: Pilot LOW — DomainEventCollector regression coverage

acceptance_criteria.description: Regression coverage proves DomainEventCollector returns recorded events in FIFO order.
Regression coverage proves pullEvents drains the collector and that events recorded after a drain are returned independently.
Exact-head canonical verification passes with no regression in the repository test suite.
The PR changes exactly the three authorized pilot paths and makes no production runtime, API, database, migration, dependency, workflow, or canonical roadmap mutation.
Deterministic classification remains LOW with Human Gate NOT REQUIRED; if classification escalates, the task must stop and follow the higher-risk policy.
The pilot merges only through the protected canonical Merge Policy workflow and is followed by exact-SHA post-merge verification before LOW pilot completion is claimed.
